fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Compare/CompareTrucks.cy.js#Compare - CompareTrucks [hi] — Compare Trucks TC-CT-02: Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Compare Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CT-02
**Title:** Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Compare Trucks
**Language:** hi

**Description:**
Open the Compare Trucks page, open the Check Offers lead form, and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Compare Trucks page
2. Open the Check Offers lead form
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
